headline: JD Sports 獲利預測下修
context: 運動服飾零售商 JD Sports 把獲利預測砍了 5000 萬英鎊，因為生活成本壓力衝擊了球鞋銷售——公司說，這波通膨是美國對伊朗開戰帶動的，尤其打擊了美國市場的年輕消費族群，讓 Nike、Adidas 等品牌的鞋款賣不動。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Inflation fuelled by Iran conflict deterring shoppers, especially in the US, says high street chain JD Sports boss is still struggling to turn up the heat The sports fashion retailer JD has cut £50m from its profit forecast as cost of living pressures, fuelled by the US war on Iran, weighed on sales of trainers. JD Sports, which sells brands including Nike and Adidas, said widespread inflation had hit shoppers’ wallets, particularly its core young shoppers, resulting in a drop in sales across important markets such as the US, where it struggled to shift trainers and other footwear. Continue reading...
sources.title: JD Sports cuts £50m from profit forecast as cost of living pressures hit trainer sales

voice_text: JD Sports 砍了獲利預測。這家運動服飾零售商把預測下修了 5000 萬英鎊——大概是新台幣 20 億。公司說，生活成本壓力衝擊了球鞋銷售，這波通膨是美國對伊朗開戰帶動的，尤其打擊美國市場的年輕消費族群，Nike、Adidas 這些品牌的鞋子都賣得不好。
